notes.title: Version 2.0 Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]Hello! Version 2.0 of Spare Parts: Episode 1 is now available to download. It features:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved sprites[/p][/*][*][p]Improved CGs[/p][/*][*][p]A completely rewritten script[/p][/*][*][p]A new song[/p][/*][*][p]New UI[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]...And probably more stuff I've forgotten! It's a complete overhaul of Episode 1. However, no change is significant enough that it would require you to reread it if you wish to keep up with the series moving forward, so don't feel any pressure to![/p][p][/p][p]Along with this update, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1620390/Spare_Parts_Episode_2/"]Spare Parts: Episode 2[/url] has received a 2.0 release as well. The changes are not nearly as extensive as Episode 1, but it has the improved sprites, some edits for quality, and some minor changes to keep it in-line with the changes made to Episode 1.[/p][p]
Let me also take this opportunity to say that Episode 3 is, indeed, still in development. An early access version is available elsewhere, if you're interested in such a thing. You can follow me on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/sopy.itch.io"]Bluesky[/url] if you'd like more updates about that.[/p][p][/p][p]If you run into any issues, please feel free to contact me at [url="https://sofycrystals@gmail.com"]sofycrystals@gmail.com[/url]. Thank you![/p]
